title: kb_feedback: an agent reports a missed or misleading lookup in closed fields, and the server spools it
goal: The team's kb MCP server (kb_mcp.py, no --roots) has a tool kb_feedback taking pack (a handle) or question, outcome (answered, partly, missed, misled), lines (at most 10 of {line: root/path:line, issue: wrong, stale, irrelevant, helpful}), best (an article path), source_url, claim (one sentence of at most 40 words), tool_issue (bad-args, unclear-output, too-long, error); annotations readOnlyHint false, destructiveHint false, idempotentHint true, openWorldHint false; it refuses a line no kb file has, a best that is no article, a url outside the research candidate url gate, a claim the leak scan flags, and a call with neither pack nor question, each as a tool error; an accepted call appends one 'feedback' row to the spool tools file through ql_capture.record (nothing else is written: D-tvjml75q) and returns 'recorded FB-<8 hex>' where the id is a hash of the fields, so a repeat call records nothing new; the server instructions gain one clause and a weak or none pack's footer names a ready kb_feedback call, a good pack prints none (D-ocy63n4a); .claude/settings.json and the plugin.md allow list name the tool.

run: import sys; s=open('.claude/settings.json').read(); p=open('kb/_self/plugin.md').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'mcp__kb__kb_feedback' in s and 'kb_feedback' in p else 1)

notes: Premise: every tool in _tools/kb_mcp.py TOOL_LIST carries READ_ONLY and none takes a report; the only feedback today is Haiku's judged and best at distill. The tool writes only the local spool under _cache/, in line with D-tvjml75q; the docs that call the server read-only (the kb_mcp.py docstring, kb/_self/plugin.md, kb/_self/tools.md) say instead that kb_feedback appends to the local spool. Exceptions only: D-ocy63n4a. Planned 2026-10-13 (SP-waxgh3kg). Premise run on base: grep -i feedback _tools/kb_mcp.py finds only a comment on submit_feedback, every TOOL_LIST entry carries READ_ONLY and none takes a report: reproduces. rag.py eval passes before the work by design: it pins that a weak or none pack's new footer line breaks no eval row. The url gate is inline in ql_research.candidate_problems: extract one predicate there (ql_research.py is in touches) that kb_mcp and ql_store both call. Extend an existing test's name with kb_feedback, no new test id; tests in _tools/test_live_kb.py and _tools/test_redact.py. Gate answered: settings.json names mcp__kb__kb_feedback in the allow list.
